# P37.47 — Tier-2 reuse wave (R11-ACQ-19)

Round-11 row 472 · `implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/472_P37.47__tier-2-reuse-wave.md live_verification=false` · base `r11/P37.46b-organisation-cascade-materializer`

## What this is

The I8 §6.2 Wave-D acquisition tranche's **Tier-2 reuse wave**: the 32
ACQ-19 plan rows, all of which ride existing connector families —
`dot_511` (ArcGIS camera layers) and `dossier_documents`
(`clause_fields` / `index_listing`) — rather than new adapter code.
`live_verification=false`: this PR lands the engineering + fixture
surfaces only; every row stays `ingestion_permitted=false` and the
operator's OP-26 Wave-D flip under ING-GO-D is the only route to a live
fetch.

## The 32 seats

**Camera layers (10 target rows over `dot_511`)**
- 8 new sources → `dot_511`: `dot_511_nm`, `dot_511_nv`, `dot_511_id`,
  `camreg_jeffersonville_in_flock`, `camreg_ca_monterey_park_flock_camera`,
  `camreg_santa_fe_nm_park_cameras`, `camreg_fl_broward_county_us_palm_beach`,
  `camreg_nv_las_vegas_us_clark_county`.
- 2 target rows ride existing gated registrations: WV Parkways
  layer-23 on `dot_511_wv`, Bellevue speed-safety on `camreg_bellevue_wa`.
- Pinned metadata: observed counts (15 WVPA · 186 NMDOT · 1,319 NDOT
  CCTV lane · 82 ITD · 12 Santa Fe · 95 Metrocams; plan estimates marked
  where no count was read), `object_id_field`, `coordinate_mode`,
  `out_fields` allowlists, `verified = 2026-09-30`, rights notes.
- Screens recorded on the rows: **verification-first** (WVPA broken
  upstream geometry — F-322 detector flags, never smooths; NMDOT/Santa
  Fe/Jeffersonville/Monterey Park publisher-identity caveats); **S2**
  (FDOT D4 Survey123 + Las Vegas + NDOT minimal-OBJECTID allowlists —
  the `Device_Typ='CCTV'` `where` filter on the NDOT row — flagged
  operator-identifier fields are never requested).

**Documents (20 rows over `dossier_documents`)**
- 15 new `clause_fields`/`index_listing` registrations (legis_vi,
  wayne-mi commission, HPD, NYC DOI OIG, NYC comptroller, anaheim,
  CMPD, DOJ COPS, OK Safe grant, elizabeth-city, chicago OIG, BART,
  SLMPD/SIUE, san jose register, santa clara, MCSO, norman PD).
- 2 curated_index S3 aggregate-only lanes ride `index_listing`
  (upturn mass-extraction, EFF Red Flag Machine) — citation predicates
  only by construction.
- 3 RB-09 flips of existing gated rows wired here: `ccops_boston`,
  `ccops_berkeley` (plan `reuse:dossier_documents`) and
  `dhs_fusion_centers` (the roster page rides `index_listing` — a
  roster is an index surface, never an oversight-report lookup;
  recorded deviation from the plan's `reuse:accountability` advisory).
